description:
One unit of a source, named by an anchor in the source's own identifiers.

A unit is the smallest place a fact can cite: a paragraph of a document, a row of a table, a
field of an application, a transaction of a stream.

anchor.description: The unit's place in its source, for example 'para:7.1'
anchor.title: Anchor

source_id.description: The id of the source the unit belongs to
source_id.title: Source Id

text_digest.description: The digest of the unit's text as the reader split it
text_digest.title: Text Digest

title: SourceUnit
